Withdrawing account analytics consent st: Withdrawing account analytics consent stops new collection and rejects queued events from an earlier consent choice. Guest activity is not automatically attached to an account, and anonymous history is not merged into account activity. Optional website-account observations use a separate receipt and can include profile-page views, profile-edit and save intentions, logout clicks and estimated active time; profile values and credentials are excluded. Intentions are separate from confirmed operational outcomes.
